root_cause_label: Network-Blocked External APIs Prevent Official URL Retrieval; Agent Fails to Pivot to Full Knowledge-Based Fallback
one_sentence_failure_summary: The Papers With Code API and DuckDuckGo search were blocked in the sandbox (returning HTML/202 instead of JSON), and when the agent recognized this at step 4, it failed to pivot to a purely knowledge-based answer, instead cycling through heuristic GitHub searches that yielded missing and incorrect entries in the final result.jsonl.
t_err_evidence: Wrote results to /app/result.jsonl; Results: [{'paper_id': '1', 'official_code_url': ''}] (commits to PWC retrieval yielding empty URLs)
t_commit_evidence: At step 18 the agent writes the final /app/result.jsonl with 10 entries: two empty (papers 3 and 9) and at least one questionable entry (paper 5 uses a non-author repo KJha02). After step 18 the agent only performs post-hoc diagnostics and then claims completion at step 20, never re-writing the file.
trigger_explanation: The real environment obstacle — network restrictions that block the Papers With Code API and DuckDuckGo search — is legitimate. However, the agent mishandled this obstacle: once the blockage was confirmed at step 4 (all 10 searches return non-JSON), the correct response would have been to immediately fall back to purely hardcoded, knowledge-based mappings for all 10 papers. Instead the agent spent steps 5-17 cycling through increasingly complex GitHub API heuristics and partial manual mappings, ultimately producing an incomplete and partially incorrect result.
